title: Kennedy's Orange Bowl promise to Cuban exiles
summary: Dan Sheehan tells of Kennedy's Orange Bowl promise to Cuban exiles, about 1962 at Orange Bowl, Miami, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: went down to Cuba. He went down to Miami at the Orange Bowl actually and convened, you know, a whole meeting

plain: A researcher, Dan Sheehan, tells on Jesse Michels's podcast how President John F. Kennedy went to the Orange Bowl, a football stadium in Miami, around 1962 and convened a large meeting there with Cuban exiles. Sheehan describes it as a promise Kennedy made to the exiles, part of his wider story about Kennedy's last years.
